description: Localization + store copy (D5/copy). Reword magicWordSaved in all 5 locales away from 'uploaded to Google Drive' to 'magic word set — takes effect on your next backup'; reword backupRestoreConfirmBody to explicitly say restore OVERWRITES local data (D12); remove the now-obsolete magicWordSavedRepacking / magicWordRepackFailed keys (no repack flow after FEAT-001); add all new keys the UI (FEAT-003) needs — 3-state restore prompt bodies, the remember-word ask, the downgrade warning, the empty-data disabled/steer hints, the next-backup status, and the stale-restore warning — in en (template, with @-metadata) plus zh_TW, zh, ja, ko with real translations. Then sync docs/release_1.6.2_store_copy.md app-facing wording. Must land before FEAT-003 (the UI references these getters). Independent of FEAT-001.
steps: In lib/l10n/app_en.arb (keep @-metadata) reword `magicWordSaved` to 'Magic word set — it takes effect on your next backup.' and reword `backupRestoreConfirmBody` to explicitly state it downloads the Google Drive backup and OVERWRITES local contacts and settings.
Remove `magicWordSavedRepacking` and `magicWordRepackFailed` (and their @-metadata in the template) from all 5 ARB files — FEAT-003 drops their only call sites.

Add new keys to app_en.arb with @-metadata and sensible English values: magicWordRestorePromptBodyNoWord ('This backup is locked with a magic word. Enter it to restore. (Case-sensitive.)'), magicWordRestorePromptBodyWrongWord ('The magic word saved on this device can\'t unlock this backup. Enter the correct one. (Case-sensitive.)'), magicWordRememberTitle ('Remember magic word?'), magicWordRememberBody ('Remember this magic word on this device so future backups and restores use it automatically?'), magicWordRememberYes ('Remember'), magicWordRememberNo ('Not now'), backupDowngradeTitle ('Remove magic-word protection?'), backupDowngradeBody ('Your Google Drive backup is currently protected with a magic word. This backup will switch to default encryption and remove that protection. Continue?'), backupEmptyDisabledHint ('Add at least one contact before backing up.'), backupRestoreFirstHint ('You have a cloud backup but no local data. Restore it before backing up or setting a magic word.'), backupSetWordNextBackupHint ('Cloud backup not yet updated with the new magic word — tap Back Up Now to apply it.'), backupRestoreStaleTitle ('Backup is older than your data'), backupRestoreStaleBody with placeholders {cloudTime} and {localTime} (type String): 'The cloud backup was made {cloudTime} — older than your latest local change {localTime}. Restoring will overwrite your newer local data with this older backup. Continue?'.

Mirror every added key and every reworded value into app_zh_TW.arb, app_zh.arb, app_ja.arb, app_ko.arb with correct, natural translations (Traditional Chinese / Simplified Chinese / Japanese / Korean). Preserve each file's existing key ordering/style; keep JSON valid; keep the {cloudTime}/{localTime} placeholders intact in every locale.
Run `fvm flutter gen-l10n` and fix any missing-translation or placeholder errors until it succeeds.

Sync docs/release_1.6.2_store_copy.md: adjust any app-facing wording that implies setting a magic word immediately uploads/re-encrypts the Drive backup, to match the 'takes effect on next backup' semantics. Leave the What's New feature blurbs (optional secret phrase) and the App Review Notes reviewer-notes section AS-IS.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 ARB files contain every new key with real (non-placeholder-English) translations and valid JSON.
magicWordSaved no longer claims an upload to Google Drive in any locale; backupRestoreConfirmBody states it overwrites local data in all 5 locales.
magicWordSavedRepacking and magicWordRepackFailed are gone from all 5 ARB files.
`fvm flutter gen-l10n` completes with no missing-translation or placeholder errors and the generated getters for all new keys exist.
docs/release_1.6.2_store_copy.md has no app-facing claim that setting a magic word immediately uploads/re-encrypts the Drive backup; reviewer-notes section unchanged.
verification: Run `fvm flutter gen-l10n` from the worktree root — succeeds with no errors.
Run `fvm flutter analyze` — no new issues introduced by the generated localizations.
findings:
Done in all 5 ARB files (app_en.arb template w/ @-metadata, app_zh_TW.arb, app_zh.arb, app_ja.arb, app_ko.arb). gen-l10n succeeds; analyze shows no NEW issues beyond the documented baseline (the only extra 2 errors are the expected unresolved references to the removed keys from backup_screen.dart, which FEAT-003 must remove).

REMOVED keys (gone from all 5 ARB + en @-metadata): magicWordSavedRepacking, magicWordRepackFailed. FEAT-003 must delete their only Dart call sites in lib/features/settings/presentation/screens/backup_screen.dart (currently line ~793 l10n.magicWordSavedRepacking and line ~812 l10n.magicWordRepackFailed(...)).

REWORDED keys (same names, new values): magicWordSaved (now 'Magic word set — it takes effect on your next backup.'), backupRestoreConfirmBody (now states it downloads the Drive backup and OVERWRITES local contacts/settings).

ADDED keys (exact final names for FEAT-003 getters on AppLocalizations):
- magicWordRestorePromptBodyNoWord : String get
- magicWordRestorePromptBodyWrongWord : String get
- magicWordRememberTitle : String get
- magicWordRememberBody : String get
- magicWordRememberYes : String get
- magicWordRememberNo : String get
- backupDowngradeTitle : String get
- backupDowngradeBody : String get
- backupEmptyDisabledHint : String get
- backupRestoreFirstHint : String get
- backupSetWordNextBackupHint : String get
- backupRestoreStaleTitle : String get
- backupRestoreStaleBody(String cloudTime, String localTime) : METHOD with two positional String args (placeholders cloudTime, localTime)

Note: the pre-existing key magicWordRestorePromptBody was NOT removed (left intact); the two new NoWord/WrongWord bodies were added alongside it per the plan.

docs/release_1.6.2_store_copy.md: no app-facing wording implied that setting a magic word immediately uploads/re-encrypts the Drive backup, so no change was needed; the reviewer-notes section is unchanged (left as-is).
